items.title: DocumentDB 1.0: A MongoDB-Compatible Document Database on Postgres
items.blurb: The first generally available release of DocumentDB, the MIT-licensed, MongoDB-compatible document database built on PostgreSQL.

items.title: PGX: Run Thousands of Throwaway Databases in One Process
pgBackRest 2.60: Restores Now Stop on Invalid Page Checksums
items.blurb: The pgBackRest Releases detail each version of the software and lists the changes made in each version.

items.title: Twelve years of distributed SQLite
items.blurb: In September 2014 I published a short post announcing rqlite. The idea was simple: take SQLite, put a Raft log in front of it, and replicate every write to a cluster so that the loss of a node did not mean the loss of the data.

items.title: CSIRO Uses Serverless Architecture to Query 100x More Genomic Variants on AWS
items.blurb: CSIRO has developed Serverless Beacon, a serverless architecture for querying genomic variants without copying VCF files into a central database.

items.title: TypeScript 7.1 content mappers made type checks 20× faster
items.blurb: I created TypeSQL , a library that type-checks raw Postgres SQL inside TypeScript's type system, with no codegen and no database connection: const q = sql("SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE id = $1", 42); // ^?
